description:
Introducing the SYNDYT BMX Racing Frames, a groundbreaking evolution in BMX frame design that sets a new standard for performance and exclusivity within the SYNDYT community.
Crafted from premium 6061 custom handcrafted alloy, these frames embody the perfect balance of durability, lightweight precision, and an unparalleled ride quality. Employing state-of-the-art hydroforming technology and featuring triple-butted tubes, our frames deliver optimal power transfer and responsiveness, enhancing your overall riding experience.
Designed with rider convenience in mind, our frames come equipped with integrated chain tensioners for easy and precise adjustments, eliminating the hassle of traditional setups. The flexibility of multi-size rear axle choices allows riders to customize their BMX for various tracks and riding styles, putting control firmly in your hands.
Embracing Oversize Technology, our frames boast the stiffest tube junctions achievable in an alloy frame. This engineering choice maximizes power transfer, providing riders with the competitive edge needed to dominate the track. The SYB BMX Racing Frames aren't just a product; they represent a commitment to delivering a superior riding experience that pushes the boundaries of what's possible in BMX racing.
Join the SYNDYT revolution and elevate your BMX game with these meticulously crafted frames – the new benchmark in racing excellence.

components.description: Includes axle hardware for 10mm bolt-on and 15mm Thru Axle
Integrated Chain Tensioner w/ 38mm of adjustment
Includes Headset for 1” Steer and Tapered 1” – 1-1/8”
